WHAT IS BEEFALO?
Beefalo is what its name suggests: 
a cross between buffalo and cattle.
The result is a dark red meat that is
very lean and has a flavor that is
slightly stronger than that of beef.
Most grocery stores do not carry
beefalo. It is available in some
specialty markets.  Although intro-
duced some years ago, beefalo has
been slow to gain popularity.  At the
same time, demand for ranch-raised
buffalo is increasing.
